window.description: Fit on these dates only; default the whole CSV.

summary_window.description: The period Meridian's HTML report summarises; default the fit window.

media_effects_dist.description: Distribution of media effects across geos. Unused in a national model.

hill_before_adstock.description: Hill saturation before adstock instead of after. Not for RF channels.

max_lag.description: Periods of carry-over in the adstock.

media_prior_type.description: Which prior the media coefficients take: roi (roi_m), mroi, contribution or coefficient. priors.roi below needs roi. Default roi.

rf_prior_type.description: Same as media_prior_type, for reach & frequency channels. Default roi.

non_media_baseline_values.description: Non-media treatment → its baseline: a value, min or max. Default min.

knots.description: Time-effect knots: a count spread evenly, or period indices. National default 1. Not with enable_aks.

enable_aks.description: Automatic knot selection. Not with knots.

baseline_geo.description: Reference geo; default the most populated.

adstock_decay_spec.description: geometric or binomial, for all channels or per channel (others geometric).

saturation_spec.description: hill or none, for all channels or per channel (others hill).

holdout.description: Not supported yet: leave it out.

priors.markdownDescription: Meridian's PriorDistribution: one TensorFlow Probability distribution per field. Fields not set keep Meridian's default. Which of roi_m, mroi_m, contribution_m, beta_m is used depends on model_spec.media_prior_type (roi by default).

Prior distribution on knots for time effects. Default distribution is `Normal(0.0, 5.0)`.

tau_g_excl_baseline.markdownDescription:
Prior distribution on geo effects, which represent the average KPI of each geo relative to the baseline geo. This parameter is broadcast to a vector of length `n_geos - 1`, preserving the geo order and excluding the `baseline_geo`. After sampling, `Meridian.inference_data` includes a modified version of this parameter called `tau_g`, which has length `n_geos` and contains a zero in the position corresponding to `baseline_geo`. Meridian ignores this distribution if `n_geos = 1`. Default distribution is `Normal(0.0, 5.0)`.

beta_m.markdownDescription:
Prior distribution on a parameter for the hierarchical distribution of geo-level media effects for impression media channels (`beta_gm`). When `media_effects_dist` is set to `'normal'`, it is the hierarchical mean. When `media_effects_dist` is set to `'log_normal'`, it is the hierarchical parameter for the mean of the underlying, log-transformed, `Normal` distribution. Meridian ignores this distribution if `paid_media_prior_type` is `'roi'` or `'mroi'`, and uses the `roi_m` or `mroi_m` prior instead. Default distribution is `HalfNormal(5.0)`.
